summary: FidelityManager.register mutates registrationCapacityRejections before validating currentLevel when the manager is already at capacity. A malformed fidelity level therefore consumes a capacity-rejection metric even though the request is invalid independently of capacity. EntityId validation already follows the opposite fail-closed ordering and existing boundary tests require invalid IDs not to consume the capacity metric. Test-adversary head 86e785b5fa19e9a576b94091969609ace881b0e7 adds a regression requiring malformed currentLevel to be rejected before capacity accounting and to create no registration.
evidence: FidelityManager.register currently checks duplicate/capacity and increments registrationCapacityRejections before resolving/asserting currentLevel.
Existing fidelity_manager_entity_id_boundary coverage requires invalid entity IDs not to consume the capacity-rejection metric, establishing fail-closed input-validation ordering for registration.
The minimal source repair is to resolve/default and validate currentLevel before the capacity branch, without changing valid at-capacity rejection behavior.
